name: follow-through
note: Authored for the Quaternius Male_Casual rig: model space has up +Y, the character's own left +X and front +Z at rest, so a right-handed golfer's target is +X. A NEGATIVE twist turns them to face it -- the sign is worth stating because reasoning it out from the right-hand rule gets it backwards. Once the spine has turned, the golfer's left points -Z and their right +Z, which is the frame the arm directions below are written in. Leg rotations stay small on purpose: Foot.L and Foot.R parent to the root rather than to the shins, because the rig drives them by IK, so a leg swung far enough to notice leaves its foot behind. The trail foot is released by rotating the foot itself, which pivots on the spot and costs nothing.
